name: dot.
description: Build something in Claude. Get feedback in seconds. Say "add dot. feedback to my artifact" and Claude creates a shareable review link — anyone can click anywhere on the page to leave pinned comments. No deploy, no signup for reviewers, no switching tabs. Works with Claude artifacts, Vercel previews, Lovable, v0, or any URL. You can also ask Claude to check your feedback or list your projects without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add dot. to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add dot. to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.leaveadot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the dot. MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: dot. provides these MCP tools: create_review_link, list_projects, and get_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to dot.?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to dot. in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
dot. requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
dot. is developed by dot.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
